items.scope: CVEs requested by code owners using the GitHub Security Advisories feature and vulnerabilities affecting open source projects discovered by security researchers at GitHub or Microsoft not covered by another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities related to products of Mitsubishi Electric Group.
SICK AG issues and issues in EHS products (when related to the Endress+Hauser SICK (EHS) joint venture).
Vulnerabilities in software discovered by DIVD, and vulnerabilities reported to DIVD for coordinated disclosure, which are not in another CNA’s scope.
Proton AG issues only.
StrongDM issues only.
Vulnerabilities in third-party products discovered by ZUSO ART that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities in AMI firmware and software products, as well as vulnerabilities discovered by AMI that are not covered by another CNA scope.
All BlackBerry products identified on https://www.blackberry.com/us/en.
Vulnerabilities in vendor products discovered by BLSOPS, or related parties, while performing vulnerability research or security assessments, unless covered by another CNA’s scope.
All Arista products only.
All Netskope products and services.
All Payara Platform product distributions (Payara Server, Micro, Embedded) for both Enterprise (commercial) and Community (OSS) distributions.
Pegasystems products only.
Elasticsearch, Kibana, Beats, Logstash, X-Pack, and Elastic Cloud Enterprise products only.
ABB issues only.
All automotive and related infrastructure vulnerabilities that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All Vaadin products and supported open source projects hosted at https://github.com/vaadin.

Kubernetes issues only.

All currently supported PTC software products and cloud/SaaS services.
Acer issues only.

Vulnerabilities in Protect AI products, third-party code vulnerabilities reported by researchers collaborating with huntr and vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, Protect AI that are not in another CNA’s scope.

Microchip Technology products only.
Juniper issues only.

Mautic core and officially supported plugins.
All Acronis products, including Acronis Cyber Protect, Acronis Cyber Protect Home Office, Acronis DeviceLock DLP, and Acronis Snap Deploy.

Vulnerabilities in the AHA! website and other AHA! controlled assets, as well as vulnerabilities identified in assets owned, operated, or maintained by another organization unless covered by the scope of another CNA.

Products and technologies branded by Bull and its subsidiaries, unless covered by the scope of another CNA as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software and hardware discovered by Bull and its subsidiaries that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Adobe issues only.
All ConnectWise products and services and vulnerabilities discovered by ConnectWise in third party products that are not within another CNA’s scope.
Dahua consumer Internet of Things (IoT) products, excludes End-of-Life products.

Vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Bombadil Systems that are not in another CNA’s scope.

All Cato Networks products and vulnerabilities in third-party products affecting Cato products unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
Products, services, and solutions developed by Canon EMEA, Canon USA Inc., and those from IRIS, NT-ware, Onyx Graphics Inc., and Therefore Corporation, which are not under the Canon Brand.
All OpenText products (including Carbonite, Zix, Micro Focus, others).
Vulnerabilities in linqi products only.
All Centreon product issues only.

Xpdf open source project, including the xpdf viewer and associated command line tools.
